name: glowthread_post
comment: One row per comment. Rows are never hard-deleted: erase blanks the text and keeps the row as a tombstone.

columns.name: gtp_id
columns.comment: Primary key, also the public comment ID

columns.name: gtp_page
columns.comment: page.page_id of the article the comment is under

columns.name: gtp_actor
columns.comment: actor.actor_id of the author (IP actors for legacy anonymous comments)

columns.name: gtp_parent
columns.comment: Display parent: gtp_id of the comment this one is shown under (depth - 1), null for top-level comments

columns.name: gtp_reply_to
columns.comment: gtp_id of the comment the author replied to. Equals gtp_parent except for replies to depth-2 comments, which are shown at depth 2

columns.name: gtp_thread
columns.comment: gtp_id of the top-level ancestor, null for top-level comments

columns.name: gtp_depth
columns.comment: Display depth: 0 top-level, 1 reply, 2 reply to a reply (deeper replies are shown at 2)

columns.name: gtp_seq
columns.comment: Per-page floor number, assigned from glowthread_page.gtpg_seq, never reused

columns.name: gtp_text
columns.comment: Plain-text source (UTF-8, NFC). Rendered on read, never stored as HTML. Empty for erased comments

columns.name: gtp_created
columns.comment: Creation timestamp

columns.name: gtp_edited
columns.comment: Last edit timestamp, null if never edited

columns.name: gtp_status
columns.comment: visible, held, deleted or erased

columns.name: gtp_hold_reason
columns.comment: Comma-separated hold reasons (filter, filter-error, spamblacklist, newaccount, reports, parentheld), null when never held

columns.name: gtp_hold_detail
columns.comment: JSON with what held the comment, {"filter": [ {"line", "rule", "type"} ]} for word-filter matches, null when there is nothing to record

columns.name: gtp_status_actor
columns.comment: actor.actor_id of whoever last changed the status (moderator or author), null if never changed

columns.name: gtp_status_timestamp
columns.comment: When the status last changed

columns.name: gtp_like_count
columns.comment: Number of likes, updated with relative SQL

columns.name: gtp_reply_count
columns.comment: Number of visible direct (display) children, updated with relative SQL

columns.name: gtp_open_report_count
columns.comment: Number of unresolved reports, updated with relative SQL

columns.name: gtp_pinned
columns.comment: When the comment was pinned, null if not pinned

columns.name: gtp_legacy_id
columns.comment: FlowThread ID as 22 lowercase hex digits, null for comments made in GlowThread

indexes.name: gtp_page_status_depth_created
indexes.comment: Page listing by status and time (new sort, hot candidates, counts)

indexes.name: gtp_page_seq
indexes.comment: Floor numbers are unique per page, and permalinks resolve by page and floor

indexes.name: gtp_actor_created
indexes.comment: User history, duplicate check and new-account gate

indexes.name: gtp_open_report_count_id
indexes.comment: Moderation queue tab reported, most reported first

name: glowthread_reaction
comment: Likes now, other reaction types later. One row per post, actor and type

columns.name: gtr_post
columns.comment: glowthread_post.gtp_id

columns.name: gtr_actor
columns.comment: actor.actor_id of the reacting user

columns.name: gtr_type
columns.comment: Reaction type, currently only like

columns.name: gtr_timestamp
columns.comment: When the reaction was made, null for imported likes

name: glowthread_report
comment: Reports against comments. One report per user and comment

columns.name: gtrp_id
columns.comment: Primary key

columns.name: gtrp_post
columns.comment: glowthread_post.gtp_id

columns.name: gtrp_actor
columns.comment: actor.actor_id of the reporter

columns.name: gtrp_reason
columns.comment: spam, abuse, offtopic, spoiler, misinfo, other, or legacy for imported reports

columns.name: gtrp_note
columns.comment: Optional free-text note from the reporter

columns.name: gtrp_created
columns.comment: When the report was filed, null for imported reports

columns.name: gtrp_resolved_actor
columns.comment: actor.actor_id of the moderator who resolved the report, null while open

columns.name: gtrp_resolved_at
columns.comment: When the report was resolved, null while open

columns.name: gtrp_outcome
columns.comment: upheld (comment removed or held) or dismissed, null while open

indexes.name: gtrp_post_actor
indexes.comment: One report per user and comment, and open reports by comment

name: glowthread_page
comment: Per-page comment state and floor counter

columns.name: gtpg_page
columns.comment: page.page_id

columns.name: gtpg_state
columns.comment: open, locked or disabled

columns.name: gtpg_actor
columns.comment: actor.actor_id of whoever last changed the state, null if never changed

columns.name: gtpg_timestamp
columns.comment: When the state last changed

columns.name: gtpg_seq
columns.comment: Last floor number handed out on this page

indexes.name: gtpg_state
indexes.comment: Pages by state, for the settings screen

name: glowthread_setting
comment: On-wiki overrides of GlowThread policy settings

columns.name: gts_name
columns.comment: Setting key

columns.name: gts_value
columns.comment: JSON-encoded value

columns.name: gts_actor
columns.comment: actor.actor_id of whoever last changed it

columns.name: gts_timestamp
columns.comment: When it was last changed
